_notes.title: The name on the title card and the browser tab. Up to 40 characters.
_notes.playerName: Your name for the scoreboard: shown on the best-score line, the result card, and the copied score. Up to 24 characters.
_notes.theme: The look: neon (magenta and cyan), ember (orange and gold), or ice (white and blue). Each has a dark and a light version that follows the device's setting.
_notes.shipColor: Your ship and its wake, as a hex color like #3dff8b.
_notes.runSeconds: How long a run lasts before the storm is cleared and overtime begins, from 20 to 600 seconds.
_notes.patterns: The bullet patterns a run cycles through, by name, in any order: Lotus, Vortex, Rain, Twin Spirals, Comb, Pulse Rings, Scatter, Wall.
